name: Cleanup After Door
intent: Final inspect, reinstall hardware (spray) or unmask hardware (brush), remove floor protection, clean tools. Glass unmask for french doors is handled by MOD_DOOR_GLASS_MASK at setup phase, not here.
doctrine: Hardware reinstall after spray (4 EA/hr = 15 minutes) is slightly slower than removal (3 EA/hr = 20 minutes per remove + 15 per reinstall = 35 minutes round trip per door). Hardware unmask after brush is fast (12 EA/hr = 5 minutes per door — just pull tape). Floor protect teardown is 20 doors/hr because door floor cloth is small and rolls up quickly.
